name: Plan Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (2019)
owner: Presidencia de la Nación Argentina — Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros
description: Plan Nacional de Inteligencia Artificial (2019). National artificial intelligence strategy of Argentina developed under the Innovative Argentina 2030 Plan, supplemented by the 2023 Recommendations for Trustworthy Artificial Intelligence in the Public Sector.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Presidencia de la Nación Argentina — Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros (argentina.gob.ar) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Presidencia de la Nación Argentina — Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros (argentina.gob.ar).
